inputs.sequence_prompt:
One uninterrupted fifteen-second live-action shot continuing exactly from this frame on the upper wooden deck of the same airship. Preserve the exact real actors, proportions, costumes, blue-hour light, fixed warm lanterns, brass rails, ropes, wooden floor, central red mast with its large curved gold fixture, and city architecture. The vessel remains docked and stationary. The camera and people move, not the ship. Only the existing three people are present.
At the first frame Celes is visible to the RIGHT of the central mast, already walking screen-right. Blonde high ponytail and blue ribbon, ivory gown with blue sash, blue boots. Locke is visible to the LEFT of the mast, walking the same direction, brown hair and blue bandana, black short jacket, cream shirt and boots, blue trousers, single wooden shield in his LEFT hand and sheathed sword. Setzer is the THIRD person: he is ALREADY ON THIS DECK, physically occluded directly BEHIND the central mast and gold fixture, walking right between them in depth. He has not left the scene. He is a tall mature clean-shaven man with long straight silver hair, a long black coat with pale gold lapels and blue inner collar, cream cravat and gold brocade waistcoat, dark trousers and boots. Cards remain stowed in his coat. His face and costume remain those of the same captain throughout.
During the first four seconds, continue the established walking rhythm toward screen-right. Setzer takes two grounded steps out from BEHIND the RIGHT edge of the mast, becoming visible progressively: silver hair and shoulder, then torso and legs. His body is fully formed behind the mast; it does not materialize on its surface. Celes sees him emerge and slows, allowing him to pass ahead with a clear gap. Locke continues a pace behind, shield low at his left thigh. The three distinct bodies remain separate and never intersect.
From four to nine seconds the camera follows gently to the right on the same side of the rail, revealing the continuation of the SAME upper deck beyond the mast. A modest wooden ship's steering wheel on a fixed brass-and-wood pedestal and one short brass control lever beside it enter naturally from the right edge as this area comes into view. They are solid equipment fixed to the deck, with consistent perspective and shadows, not objects appearing in an already empty visible area. Keep the familiar mast and gold fixture toward frame left, the same floorboards connected across the shot, and the stationary city in the background. Setzer reaches the wheel in a few purposeful steps, stops behind it with both boots planted, and takes one wheel handle in his left hand. Celes stops a pace behind and to his side, clear of his arms. Locke stops behind them and glances toward the dock. No one touches or passes through the mast, rail or another person.
During the final six seconds Setzer turns his head toward his companions and speaks one calm decisive sentence in natural Brazilian Portuguese, with synchronized lips: <d>[Portuguese] Segurem-se. Vou ligar os motores.</d> He then looks down at the short lever, closes his RIGHT gloved hand around its handle, and moves that single rigid lever smoothly forward along its mechanical arc until it reaches its stop. His left hand stays on the fixed wheel. Only after this visible lever movement does a low mechanical engine hum begin. Celes responds to the sound by planting her feet more firmly and resting one hand on the nearby brass rail. Locke turns his gaze back to Setzer, ready to leave, keeping his shield left and weapon sheathed. End with the three of them at the helm station, Setzer in command and companions settled behind him. The ship remains motionless at the dock; the gangway has not been released and no takeoff occurs.
Camera motion is a restrained continuous rightward follow and pan, preserving the original viewing axis and physical depth. No cut, sudden zoom, reset, new location or close-up hiding contacts. Natural body weight and independent listening reactions at normal speed. Existing warm lighting remains steady; no flashing lights, magical glow, sparks or explosions. Audio: exactly the single Portuguese sentence above, soft footsteps, cloth and wind, one control click at contact, then subdued mechanical hum. No other speech, music, narration or singing.
